title: Minuta 2025-06-26
summary: The minutes of the 26 June meeting (50bp cut to 8.00%, 4-1 with Heath for a hold) show a Board more cautious than the communique: all four members in the majority argue that the cycle should now continue at a slower pace, two explicitly calling this the last 50bp cut and another proposing smaller adjustments, citing a rate differential with the Fed already below its historical average and the rise in core inflation (4.20%, broad-based, six consecutive fortnightly increases). The easing case is still there, since the majority sees slack, two quarters of contracting demand, a cooling labor market, an appreciating peso and a still-restrictive real rate, and one member says rules still point to 'cierto espacio para realizar ajustes adicionales'. Heath's dissent is forceful: the room for recalibration is exhausted, the cut brings the rate close to the upper bound of neutrality and sends a message of complacency that costs credibility, and he wants inflation to resume falling before further cuts; one other member says the risk balance has deteriorated. Versus the May minutes, where four members backed the 50bp pace and only one wanted to drop the similar-magnitude guidance, the push for gradualism has become the majority view, so these minutes read half a point more hawkish than the June communique.

key_quotes.quote: es conveniente comunicar que hacia delante se adoptará un enfoque más gradual en el ciclo de disminuciones, teniendo en consideración toda la información relevante.
key_quotes.context: Member in the majority who frames this as the last 50bp cut

key_quotes.quote: Externó que, por ello, aún existe cierto espacio para realizar ajustes adicionales a la tasa objetivo.
key_quotes.context: Another majority member: rules still point to room for further, more gradual cuts

key_quotes.quote: se podrían valorar ajustes de menor magnitud en la tasa, de manera que se atiendan ambos lados del balance de riesgos.
key_quotes.context: A majority member proposes smaller cuts once calibration ends

key_quotes.quote: El ajuste realizado en esta decisión pone en riesgo el mantenimiento de una postura monetaria lo suficientemente restrictiva, dado que lo acerca al umbral superior de la zona de neutralidad.
key_quotes.context: Heath's dissent for a hold: room exhausted, credibility at risk
